reviews.x: This bottle sprayed a couple of time then stopped. They actually exchanged it. Then the new bottle did the same thing. It do not work.

reviews.t: This Mist Spray Bottle Does What It's Supposed To Do
reviews.x: I was looking for a spray bottle to tame the head hair and beard hair in the evenings and occasional mornings where I didn't have time to shower. It was surprisingly hard to track one of these down in stores — or even online. Not sure if it is due to the pandemic or just being such a specific product. I decided to try out this interesting looking spray bottle/mister from Segbeauty on Amazon and I am happy with the product. It seems like something that was built overseas, but the quality is still

Very nice fine, refreshing mist for my Macaw. I adopted a Macaw who'd been neglected, semi abused and was sprayed with a water bottle on hard stream for punishment when he'd caw too loud. (It's what they do for attention and to communicate and doesn't bother me a bit) Bird's need the occasional moisture, bath, etc, so I needed something that misted a fine, light mist and didn't look like a big, scary water bottle. This mister works like a charm. My Macaw actually likes it and I couldn't be happi

reviews.t: Much better that your average spray bottle!
reviews.x: This is a great spray bottle. I bought it to use on my curly hair and I love that you don't have to pump it constantly, instead it gives off a long, continuous light mist thats perfect.  I also really like that you can use it upside down, something that you can't usually do with regular water bottles.  I've only used it for a few days, but it seems to be very sturdy.  I usually take a much smaller water bottle with me when I travel so I'm not sure yet if I'll use it for that, but it may turnout

Just threw it in the trash today, it worked perfectly and great for about a month and a half max and it just stopped misting nothing happened to it it just didn't mist when I picked it up one day. If was clearly used before what they send you are returns because they work for a month and then get sent back probably... My bottle came with water in the sucking part inside it could've been tested before but I highly doubt that considering it only lasted a month. It works great and I absolutely love

I’ve been let down by plant misters over and over again, with flimsy handles that break off, and sprayers after sprayer that claim to make a fine mist, but only make droplets, sputter and shoot water sideways, leaks, etc. I’d been avoiding a plastic mister and sticking with metal/glass ones up till now, thinking that plastic misters would have all the above problems, but amplified.  I was wrong. This is waaaay sturdier, I have no worries it’s gonna randomly poop out on me if I look at it sideway

reviews.t: Great mister for an affordable price!
reviews.x: Easily one of the most enjoyable misters I've used. I grow a lot of indoor seedlings, herbs, and other plants so a good mister is important for keeping them free of fungi and growing hapily. This mister in particular has done amazing work, it produces a very fine mist and you can generate a consistent, continuous stream of mist to layer over plants (or on a hot day, your own head) with ease. It's pretty sturdy and easy to refill. I only wish I could buy a larger water reservoir for misting large

I use this sprayer for NEEM Oil and Bonners pure Castile liquid soap (diluted with water). It gets rid of powdery mildew and helps control aphids.  Great sprayer. One fluid motion with the sprayer and it covers about 24 square inches with mist. I don't know how it works...but, it is an awesome sprayer.

This is literally how I received the bottle. This was clearly a return and I can understand why. It worked GREAT for a week until it randomly stopped spraying and the nozzle clogged. There was nothing but water in the bottle so it doesn't make sense as to why it would clog. I constantly changed the water so the smell wouldn't occur and to prevent clogging. For this price, I'll settle with carpal tunnel in my wrist from a manual spray bottle.

Water bottle is not continuous spray, had to pump the trigger about 40 times before it would even spray at all,   the mist is definitely a fine mist but you must constantly pump the trigger to get it to spray and it is not a continuous spray. Overall the sprayer is pretty sturdy, feels nice in the hand but does not work as advertised.  😞 disappointed

reviews.t: Ordered in late January 2020.  Broke by early May.  Now non-functional.
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:2c744234b5da019117e726443c247b85]] This bottle was amazing.  Until it stopped working today.  It won't spray at all.  I've never dropped or manhandled it, be careful as it seems the trigger mechanism is very fragile!

This mister, although has multiple uses, was strictly purchased to give my curly coils some TLC. It has certainly met the mark in terms of ease of use. It’s not difficult to use the pump feature. It’s light weight and you can travel with it. As far as the mister...oh my oh my...it’s super lovely! It lightly mist your hair like morning dew. This is such a useful feature bc your curly coils or wavy waves will stay intact. Unlike other spray bottles that spew out huge droplets breaking up your curl

reviews.t: Easy to fill, easy to use.
reviews.x: This sprayer is much better than others I've had.  It's recommended by a youtuber - Manes by Mell and I find her reviews honest.  This is a cinch to fill up and sprays a very fine mist.  Excellent for refreshing curly hair.  I tend to dump the unused water and refill it because somewhere I read that if you keep using the same water it gets smelly.  No complaints - works great.

reviews.t: This does not work despite excellent reviews!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:ec508929a3273763e8af107b67dd2b65]] I bought this product to use as a mister for my plants after reading excellent reviews of it and plant blogs and Amazon. Unfortunately it doesn’t work. I am returning it.
[[VIDEOID:830c600b002a0bfb01df18c5428aaf83]] We loved this water bottle when we received it, but within 2 months the misting stopped and it now sprays like a basic water bottle.

My daughter has Shirley Temple hair; red, thick and tight curls. So we go through detangler and curl products like crazy. Recently I’ve noticed I have better results with her hair if I use a leave in conditioner opposed to detangler, but I did want a spray version of the leave in conditioner I like for her hair. That’s where this bottle comes in. I just fill it with water, squirt a little bit of the leave in conditioner into the bottle, pop the top back on, shake it up, and I’m good to go. Even

Works exactly how I wanted it - I use it for Witch Hazel to spray and its a super fine mist.  It really works at any angle which is awesome and lets you use up all of it before having to refill it.  Small enough that I was able to travel with it (no leaks!), but big enough to hold a lot of liquid.  Since it is a fine mist I dont think you could use anything that isn't purely liquid without any settlement in it, but for witch hazel its been fine.  The instructions do say meant for water only - so

My husband bought one to grow mushrooms. I immediately realized it would solve my problem of getting too much water in my paints and bought one myself. So many reasons to have this item around, whether it’s  watering indoor plants, cooling on a hot day, applying window film, cleaning a mirror, settling hair—so many uses. It also feels ergonomic. None of that trigger sprayer design. The entire hand wraps around the bottle which needs just a gentle squeeze.  Very happy with this versatile device.

I initially ordered this spray bottle to mist a fresh evergreen wreath during the holidays but have subsequently found multiple uses for it, from reenergizing the curls in my wavy hair to using on the ironing board when pressing a shirt. Easy to open, fill and use, and also like the continuous spray feature. How did I manage to live so long w/o one of these?? Great product at a good price point. Very sturdy and well made. NOT cheap feeling at all. Love it!

This spray bottle gives a nice even mist when used. My daughter has curly hair so I use this for her hair product. The packaging shows that it would also work good for misting plants and de-wrinkling clothes. The bottle holds 160ml (5.4oz). When filling up the bottle make sure you don’t fill it over the line where the neck starts otherwise you are just waisting product. It takes about 20 presses on the trigger to get the pressure built up for the sprayer.

Mildew smell. After one use the water that it sprayed smelled disgusting. I bought this specifically to use on my hair and musky/mildewy water is the last thing I want to spray on it. It literally started smelling like mildew the very next morning after the first use. It is not a continuous spray. The spray is misty though, but not worth the price when it smells that awful.

I bought this for my stepdaughter to use when we fix her hair. She is mixed and has very fluffy hair. We have to spray it down with water in the mornings before add creams to it and brush it out. I love that you can create a continuous type mist by squeezing the handle consecutively and how it isn’t as aggressive as those one stream water spray bottles. She loves it!

This is a nice sized bottle, but the magic is in the continuous mist.  I use this on my children’s hair, & while it can be somewhat hard to squeeze, it gets their hair wet so much quicker than a regular squirt bottle. We have had it for approx. six months; it has been dropped multiple times, and is holding up well.

This is a great mister.  I use it for my plants and it works great.  I like that the mist is really fine which gives nice coverage for my plants.  Easy to use and a good size.  I like the pump mechanism that keeps the mist going at the end of a pump.  Good purchase.

Pulled product box out of envelope mailer to discover unidentifiable blue blobs of gunk smeared on the product box... no idea what this sticky crud is. Not the type of service us customers deserve. Won't attempt to open - sending back. Poor quality control.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the fine, continuous mist and find it easy to use, especially for hair and plants.
A common complaint is that the sprayer stops misting or breaks after a short period of use, sometimes within weeks or a couple of months.
Some reviewers report receiving used or returned units that failed to work properly.
Several reviewers note it is not a true continuous spray and requires constant pumping of the trigger.

qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability: some say it holds up well over months of use [5][3], while another reports it stopped misting after about a month and a half [4].

Another reviewer describes it as very sturdy and well made [3].
